summary: Implemented Lambda (vanilla) and Lambdad (dictionary) transforms per the spec. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda appended at the end; monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets the Callable and Lambda imports, the Lambdad class after ConcatItemsd, and the LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line at the end of the alias block; docs/source/transforms.rst gets Lambda before SplitChannel and Lambdad after ConcatItemsd; new tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity and slicing callables. Git diff confirms the only removed line in the dictionary module is the original typing import. Nothing was committed, and tests, flake8, and black were not run because the task prohibited executing repository code, so correctness is verified by reading only.
